<!--
  One card per talk. To add a talk: make a folder talks/<name>/ with an
  index.qmd (copy talks/aar-2026/index.qmd as a model) and add a card below,
  newest first. The card classes (mx-sec-grid, mx-sec-card ...) are the same
  ones the Report page uses, so no new styles are needed.
-->

```{=html}
<div class="mx-sec-grid">
  <a class="mx-sec-card mx-reveal" href="aar-2026/index.html">
    <span class="mx-sec-num">Nov 2026</span>
    <span class="mx-sec-title">The Future of the Past</span>
    <span class="mx-sec-desc">AAR Annual Meeting, Denver. How six AI models answer questions about Macrina and Olympias, and why they flatten more than they err. Paper, slides and figures.</span>
  </a>
</div>
```
